reason: I might let them run the free missed-call check to see the numbers, but I won't hand my phone line to two guys with no customers yet. If something breaks, my regulars get a text robot instead of me, and at 62 my name is all I've got.

would_change_my_mind: If the free check shows I'm really losing several paying jobs a week, and another Handwerker nearby I know has used it for a few months without problems.
